info.title: Interfere API
info.description: Register builds, ingest telemetry, and inspect application issues. Build operations authenticate with a secret surface key; SDK ingestion uses a publishable surface key. Dashboard operations require a Clerk session, and investigation endpoints require workload identity. Authentication alternatives are listed on each operation. Retry only when the operation contract permits it, preserving the original idempotency key.

clerkSession.description: Clerk session or delegated OAuth access token of an Interfere user. Workspace routes also accept API keys with explicit permission scopes.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying this request

post.description: Read the authenticated workspace's current details and settings. Pass the workspace slug in the URL and operation arguments inside the JSON body as { args: ... }. Inspect the request schema for required fields and exact identifier formats. This operation is read-only despite using POST. Permission-filtered queries may return an empty result; do not assume that proves the resource does not exist. Only use pagination arguments declared in the schema.
